fourpage.description: FourPage lets you read EPUB and PDF books, convert TXT, Markdown, HTML, and DOCX files into readable books, and organize your collection with custom shelves. You can customize fonts, spacing, margins, and themes, switch between page turning and continuous scrolling, and save important passages with bookmarks, colored highlights, and notes. It also includes in-book search, reading statistics, break and daily reading reminders, and a home-screen widget for picking up where you left off. Your books, reading progress, and annotations stay on your device, with offline reading and optional online dictionary lookups.
